title: Render records as an aligned GitHub markdown table
prompt: Our CLI prints results as markdown tables and the output looks ragged, especially with Japanese product names and emoji. Please implement renderTable(rows, options) in table.js; the comment at the top of that file is the spec (column order, alignment defaults, escaping, padding, and how to measure the display width of text). Node built-ins only — no npm packages. report.js shows how it's used.
